biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the 25,000-point bonus (a $250 statement credit toward travel and dining) is yours to keep net — but the official page I could access did not state when the bonus posts after you qualify, so you will have to track it yourself.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
You must spend at least $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days — keep it to your already-planned spending.
The 25,000 points are 'online bonus points'; their headline value is as a $250 statement credit toward travel or dining purchases.
Bank of America did not state the bonus posting timing on the fetched card page — do not assume a date.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.

steps: Go to the official Bank of America Travel Rewards page https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/products/travel-rewards-credit-card/ and read the 25,000-point terms.
Apply online and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Spend at least $1,000 in purchases — your already-planned spending — within the first 90 days.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
Track the 25,000 points posting; the official page did not state a posting lag, so check your rewards balance and statements.
Redeem for a $250 statement credit toward a travel or dining purchase.
